game: Weird Al’s Museum of Natural Hilarity

sections.Overview:
Explore Weird Al’s Museum of Natural Hilarity on your P 3 Pinball Platform !
This listing is for a game kit for a P 3 you already own. The full game kit price is $3500.
To order a new P 3 with this and/or other game kits: click here
Weird Al’s Museum of Natural Hilarity is based on the music and career of “Weird Al” Yankovic, the 5-time Grammy award-winning singer, musician, and actor. It features 17 Weird Al songs, over 2000 custom callouts from Al himself, and a software and graphics package that immerses the player into his songs and lyrics. Song List: The game includes a feature-rich playfield layout that presents a museum full of interactive and hilarious references that span all of Al’s illustrious career. In addition to the physical features, the LCD integrated into the P 3 ‘s lower playfield delivers even more gameplay immersion by changing to represent a themed environment for each song. Examples include: To purchase this game kit for an existing P 3 , add this product to your cart. To purchase a new P 3 with this and/or other game kits, Click here. A Standard Edition artwork package (or a different artwork package, at the buyer’s request) is included with the purchase of a new P 3 . Existing P 3 owners can choose to purchase some or all of the Standard Edition artwork package separately. Weird Al’s Museum of Natural Hilarity is designed as a 5-flipper game (lower flippers, both side target flippers, and a pre-installed flipper on the playfield module’s second level). Note – This game requires both a Left and Right Side-Target Flipper Assembly (each sold separately). New P 3 s come with both assemblies. P 3 s built prior to 2022 did not.
